LESSON: READING 4.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to interpret visuals correctly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read visuals in print and digital formats for information,
2. interpret visual media appropriately for comprehension,
3. acknowledge the importance of visual media for lifelong learning. The learner is guided to: in different formats such as audio, video and animated stories, photographs, comics showing an underpass, foot bridge, luggage rack, roundabout, railway crossing, discuss visuals, comics and write down their thoughts. maps and find the direction of various places on the map, printed maps to give directions, important to interpret visuals correctly? like photos and videos enhance our understanding of a text? 28 map and make short sentences using terms like north, south, east and west. For example, ‘The sun rises in the east.’

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals.
2. Explain Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read age-appropriate digital texts in different formats such as audio, video and animated stories,
4. Show that you can: read visuals in print and digital formats for information,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is it important to interpret visuals correctly?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read age-appropriate digital texts in different formats such as audio, video and animated stories,
2. Work together to interpret and discuss visuals,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. interpret visual media appropriately for comprehension,
